intro: The Reconstructed Tome is a pieced-together grimoire of dark cabal lore, compiled for warlocks seeking to expand their mastery of demonic servants. It contains the arcane knowledge and rituals necessary to summon and bind a predatory felhunter from the Twisting Nether.

p: Recovered in fragments and painstakingly pieced back together, the Reconstructed Tome represents an elusive collection of cabal teachings known formally as the Tome of the Cabal. Warlocks of both the Alliance and the Horde go to great lengths to restore its frayed leaves, consulting occult scholars eager for a mere glimpse of its esoteric contents before surrendering the completed manuscript.
